emerging_themes.description: $3.6B federal programs, $18.5B partnership mobilization, $2B sovereign fund, $1.5B First and Last Mile Fund. Fast-tracked projects in SK and BC. Four cobalt mines under development. Lithium processing in BC.

VW PowerCo (St. Thomas) foundations complete. NextStar (Windsor) battery module production commenced. $3B Strategic Response Fund. Domestic lithium refineries opening 2026. Some projects facing pauses and reevaluations.
$890M federal AI Sovereign Compute Program (7 years). Microsoft $19B Canada commitment. Applications for 100+ MW sovereign data centres close June 1. ~$10M/MW construction + $30M/MW compute cost.

Defence spending to 2% GDP (~$63B), targeting 5% by 2035. 70% domestic procurement mandate. Defence Industrial Strategy projects 125,000 careers and 240% industry revenue growth. Canada joined EU SAFE ($243B fund).

Indigenous Loan Guarantee Program doubled to $10B, expanded beyond energy. $850K+ for 14 Northern Ontario critical minerals projects. $1.5B First and Last Mile Fund. Northern Horizons training 1,200 Indigenous/northern women.
LNG Canada Phase 1 (14 MTPA) ramping to full capacity 2026; Phase 2 FID expected by end of 2026 (would double to 28 MTPA). Woodfibre LNG exports expected 2027. Cedar LNG exports expected 2028.
